title: Gap Purchase Share for Patients Paying Cash Repeatedly — Prescription Insurance on File Re-Bills
content:
Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, a patient with repeated gap purchases earns a gap share when a cash fill is re-billed. The purchases counted are the patient's fills paid in cash, as the Prescriptions fill ledger records them, dispensed less than **3** whole months before the day of the re-bill.

## Rule

- **3** or more such cash fills: the charge is multiplied by **0.8**.
- Exactly two such cash fills: the charge is multiplied by **0.9**.
- Otherwise: the charge is multiplied by 1.

The share multiplies the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent is made once, at the end.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical, re-bill on 20 June)

| Cash fills dispensed less than 3 whole months before 20 June | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 0.9 |
| 3 | 0.8 |
| 5 | 0.8 |

- A cash fill dispensed on 21 March is less than 3 whole months before 20 June and counts; one dispensed on 20 March is exactly 3 whole months before and does not.
- Cash fills of every prescription of the patient count, including the cash fill being re-billed when it falls in the window.
